verdict.rationale: Sentry documents first-party natural-language operation. Its official MCP server lets AI assistants search errors, analyze performance, triage issues and manage projects. The @sentry/agent-plugin wires Sentry into assistants so you can "just ask" to set up projects, debug error spikes or configure alerts. Seer adds conversational root-cause analysis and fix generation. missing for 10: an evidenced native in-app natural-language command interface (operation runs mainly through third-party assistants), and independent or hands-on corroboration of how reliably NL commands work.
